register_move_fn_custom_action: register a custom SceneNodeControl class with register_move_fn to define new agent movement actions
create_actuation_spec_dataclass: create an attrs dataclass like MoveAndSpinSpec to parameterize custom action controls with forward and spin amounts
add_action_to_agent_config: add a custom ActionSpec to the agent configuration action space dictionary with a registered control name
run_simulator_with_custom_actions: run the habitat simulator and step with custom registered actions like fwd_and_spin or strafe_left
define_strafe_action: define a strafe action using quat_from_angle_axis and quat_rotate_vector to move perpendicular to the forward direction
